findings: All749 prior sources, compiled inputs and citation contexts preserved; one authentic thesis and one exact project reference added.
Mixed posterior graph metrics and unreported adverse feedback trials constrain the source conclusions.
The response-frequency/truth distinction, graph-conditioning example and categorical posterior are explicit.
Appendix seed/sample-count gaps and source semantic discrepancies remain visible; no native integration claimed.
limitations: Author source, mathematical and extracted-page review; no independent or rendered visual acceptance.
Thesis experimental results are reported means, not newly reproduced trials or significance tests.
Exact rational examples are project derivations; no DiBS, AGFN, DSPy or model-provider execution.
Original census remains40 inspected/73 unread of113; source coverage and software decisions remain open.
Q1/Q5 and all mandatory manuscript repair gates remain open.
